sentences.text: Maryborough District Health Service reported on its 2025–2026 urgent care, hospital, aged care, home and community services at Maryborough, Avoca and Dunolly.
MDHS reported completing a $4.3 million logistics hub upgrade covering waste management, linen handling, sterile supply storage, an engineering workshop and electric vehicle charging.
sentences.section: Creating places where people feel cared for

sentences.text: It reported four- and five-star overall aged care ratings and meeting 100 per cent of assessed hospital accreditation standards.
MDHS reported an operating surplus of $1.580 million and a surplus from transactions of $0.862 million.

items.quote: MDHS met Australian Commission on Safety and Quality in Health Care (ACSQHC) accreditation outcomes with 100 per cent of assessed standards met across hospital services.
